name: Paribus Camelot PNFT instantaneous-position oracle
summary: Paribus's direct Algebra V1 position oracle valued a Camelot liquidity NFT from the pool's instantaneous globalState without a time-weighted or deviation constraint. Once that oracle, pool and PNFT market were enabled, the lending controller accepted the transient position valuation and released four scarce reserve assets against collateral whose fair pre-event value was much lower.

loss.notes: The four Paribus reserves are the victim entity. At block 296699666 they hold 12.599960598441767978 native ETH, 6,510.273280264926258675 ARB, 0.36729789 WBTC and 3,924.210566 USDT; each balance is zero at block 296699667. The same receipt records helper 0xa8906930 debts in exactly those principal amounts. At the independently preceding marks the four gross products are $41,494.064243182445887469820, $5,041.386361131872006635194450, $37,757.12119833 and $3,924.210566, totalling exactly $88,216.782368644317894105014450. Canonical Arbitrum USDT reports six decimals and is valued at par. NFT 224023, retained by the Paribus PNFT custodian, has ticks -870000/+870000 and liquidity 261501642958000974. Applying the deployed LiquidityAmounts integer floors to the block-minus-one sqrtPriceX96 1993589943807320009052 gives 10,392,455.444702046400702691 PBX plus 6,580.072402 USDT. Camelot pool 0x25874cc60cbf7495b7cd1fa724178d251cfad5a8 then held 32,061,295.168839585435883621 PBX, 12,479.674453 USDT and active liquidity 466540172465242247; its exact spot was 0.00063315858681153637624319371523608944190276287934929122266559846865593598578993264 USDT per PBX. The position's fair pre-event value is therefore exactly $13,160.144804869404522237652225787648445816117581853463500053413592978259905749617, and gross reserve value less that attacker-supplied collateral consideration is $75,056.637563774913371867362224212351554183882418146536499946586407021740094250383. Two Uniswap V3 PBX/USDT pools had zero active liquidity and only dust; this Camelot pool was the only credible active market. DefiLlama's independently preceding $0.00060716 PBX mark at 1737197908 would value the position at $12,889.95564980529449265064586756, a disclosed 2.05% sensitivity, but the immediate onchain block-minus-one market is selected. Later recovery is not netted from exploit-time loss. The attacker swept and returned exactly 12.599 native ETH, all 6,510.273280264926258675 ARB, and the 10,283.193627-USDT final receipt residual to governance address 0x8ad8328166764ad208ae8dfe90ae766a1f0aee65. The residual includes the receipt's sale of all 0.36729789 WBTC for 37,912.265247 USDT, together with the pUSDT draw and PBX round trip, after the 3,093,209.807085-USDT Aave principal and 1,546.604904-USDT premium were repaid; it is not the WBTC proceeds alone. The returned ETH is 0.000960598441767978 below the pETH principal. Governance later withdrew the underlying NFT from the PNFT custodian in transaction 0x9bfa37a9 and burned it in transaction 0x125c5f6a, receiving 17,018,151.157492337382342522 PBX and 4,176.682356 USDT. The helper still owns the wrapper token, but the underlying NFT no longer exists, so that wrapper carries no residual underlying claim. No RepayBorrow event names the helper after the incident; all four reserve cash balances remain zero and the four debts remain outstanding and accrued at head.

ageReset.description: The PNFT delegator whitelisted the Camelot pool at creation, the direct oracle emitted PairSupported for this pool on 2024-12-16, and the Comptroller bound AggregatorOracle 0xa185a8c0929d473f2d0d2a132c4464fc01380bce the next day. This governance transaction is the later and last causal activation: it lists pNFT 0xa26b6df27f520017a2f0a5b0c0aa9c97d05f1f26 and sets its 20% collateral factor, changing markets(pNFT) from (false,0) to (true,0.2e18). No later pool-support, oracle, PNFT implementation, market-listing or collateral-factor event affecting this path occurs before the incident.

sources.note: Reviewed the complete 63-log loss receipt and historical trace; all ETH, ARB, WBTC, USDT and PBX transfers; four reserve and helper debt states before and after the receipt and at head; the Camelot NFT position, block-minus-one pool state and alternative active-market census; EOA nonces 10-22, helper and top-level target end states, financing repayment, asset disposal and exact later returns; PNFT custody, governance withdrawal, NFT burn and recovery receipts; verified Paribus sources; the direct Algebra oracle's nested creation and runtime history; every PairSupported event; PNFT whitelist and implementation events; Comptroller oracle, market-listing and collateral-factor events; and the live oracle call path. The exploit receipt empties the four named reserves and mints equal principal debt to helper 0xa8906930. USDT conservation is exact: Aave supplies 3,093,209.807085 USDT to the top target and helper; helper also receives 1,469,993.322718 USDT from its PBX sale, 3,924.210566 from pUSDT and 37,912.265247 from disposing all 0.36729789 WBTC, then pays 1,000,000 to the PBX pool, 500,000 into NFT224023 and 3,105,039.605616 back to the top target. The target repays Aave 3,094,756.411989, leaving exactly 10,283.193627, which the EOA later returns to governance. The helper sweeps all 6,510.273280264926258675 ARB to the EOA and the EOA returns it in full; the receipt forwards all 12.599960598441767978 native ETH to the EOA and it later returns 12.599 ETH. No later helper repayment exists. The PNFT custodian holds underlying NFT224023 while the helper holds the wrapper. Governance upgrades the PNFT only after the incident, withdraws that underlying to 0x8ad8328166764ad208ae8dfe90ae766a1f0aee65, and later burns it for the exact PBX and USDT amounts recorded in loss.notes; the helper's wrapper therefore no longer has an underlying claim. Direct target 0x48288207 is a CREATE child of AggregatorOracle 0xa185a8c0 in source-3, not a top-level EOA creation: the creation trace contains the exact parent-child CREATE frame. It is absent at block 277187884 and its 5,568-byte runtime hashes to 0xd18a6b61c4f46830fce8d68169f26daa7aa6dd8275ead0cba3fc6e37707c5d9e at creation, PairSupported, market activation, anchor minus one and head. The loss trace STATICCALLs this direct runtime 21 times, including getPositionPrice(uint256), and it reads the NFT manager position and Camelot pool globalState. The verified source applies LiquidityAmounts to that instantaneous sqrt ratio and has no TWAP, observation-window or deviation check. The PNFT creation transaction whitelists this pool and selects delegate 0x724e4c7a72bc285e0d602222f7e220e5eaf347e5; source-5 is the pool's sole preincident PairSupported event; source-6 binds the main aggregator as Comptroller oracle; source-7 finally lists the PNFT and establishes its collateral factor. No later preincident event changes any of those bindings. The latest configuration is therefore the honest reset and code/configuration age is 1,737,200,705 - 1,735,893,165 = 1,307,540 seconds.

notes: This is the January 2025 Camelot PNFT oracle incident. It is independent of Paribus's April 2023 pETH redeem-reentrancy review and has a different direct runtime hash and failure identity.
